introduction.p: You have a bag of special math-themed M&Ms. The bag promises that inside there are 1 blue, 4 red, 2 orange, 1 green, 1 brown, and 5 yellow M&Ms.
Find the probabilities of the following events.

statement.p: What is the probability that if you pick a single M&M, it is blue or yellow?
What is the probability that if you pick two M&Ms at the same time, you will get a blue and yellow?
What is the probability that if you pick two M&Ms one at a time, you will get a blue first and a yellow second?
